name: Electrical Technology
description: Electrical programmes train the people who install, maintain and repair the wiring, panels, circuits and fixtures a building runs on — residential, commercial and industrial — to the National Electrical Code and to the inspector's satisfaction.
degreesNote: Florida publishes this as clock-hour career certificates that stack: **Electricity, 1,200 hours** in three occupational completion points — electrician helper, residential electrician, commercial electrician — and **Electrician, 1,500 hours**, which adds industrial. A **750-hour half** covers the first two points for students who need to start earning sooner. ⚠ A second route exists and is the traditional one: a **registered apprenticeship**, where the classroom half runs as Electrical Wiring I–VIII at state colleges while you work for pay. ⚠⚠ Neither route licenses you: Florida licenses the CONTRACTOR, and journeyman requirements are set by counties and municipalities rather than by the state.

cips.note: Electrician — the programme itself: **41 Florida public institutions** and 741 credentials in 2023, one of the largest career certificates in the state and taught mostly at district technical colleges.

related.note: ⚠ Closer than it looks: most HVAC service calls are electrical faults, and the two trades share circuits, controls and the same technical colleges. A common second certificate in either direction.
The step up: electrical and electronics engineering technology degrees lead to controls, industrial automation and estimating — and they pair with the contractor's licence rather than replacing it.
